lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. You’re making a careful call. Since you feel unsafe going back tonight, please don’t return there if you can avoid it. If he shows up, threatens you again, or you feel in immediate danger, call nine one one right away. We can do this quietly: I can connect you to a live advocate now, and I’ll pass along “privacy first, phone-only, no texts, no mail.” We can take this one step at a time.
